# Miles Fitzgerald

> Product leader and angel investor helping early-stage founders build AI-first products people love to use. Design Director at Microsoft working on AI agents in Excel, based in Barcelona. Previously Spotify, Condé Nast and Adobe. Speaker and writer.

Fifteen years crafting software for everyone from the Fortune 500 to folks on the subway. Still gets a kick out of spotting the work in the wild.

## Investments & advisory

Writes $25k+ pre-seed and seed cheques into AI-first tools, with a network of investors who invest alongside him. Then sticks around: design reviews, help hiring a first designer, and a zero-to-one product leader who has shipped at billion scale. Most angels bring a cheque. Miles brings fifteen years of shipping, more cheques, and a seat at the table. Send him your deck: miles.fitzgerald@gmail.com

- [Biscuit](https://www.biscuit.so/): invested
- [Pretty Data](https://www.prettydata.co/): invested

## Work

- **Now** — Microsoft Excel: Design Director, shipping AI agents to a billion+ people and their spreadsheets
- **2017** — Microsoft Outlook: led design for mobile on iOS and Android, took it from 100M to 300M+ weekly active users around the world
- **2015** — RogerTalk: founding member of a venture-backed zero-to-one, $1M raised from Chamath Palihapitiya, grew to 100K+ users
- **2014** — Spotify: helped grow mobile to millions and usher in the black/green era. Personalization went on to take it from $6B to $19B
- **2011** — The Cools: a fashion marketplace with 50K users, LVMH's Antoine Arnault advising and the fashion press watching

## Things I make

- [BlixtSnap](https://milesfitzgerald.github.io/BlixtSnap/#install): a Mac app for screenshots
- [Essential Mix](https://milesfitzgerald.github.io/essential-mix/): a SoundCloud mixtape for makers looking to flow
- [NYC subway app](https://www.nytimes.com/2015/03/01/nyregion/clocking-your-train.html): an iOS app for the MTA, featured in The New York Times
